scope: instructions, review, integrations, providers, search, pipeline/_resources.py
method: Read each complete function body and module-level contracts; record findings and applied repairs. This is scoped source review, not execution proof.

findings.detail: Preserve an already-correct terminal outcome label instead of removing/re-adding it; settled projections emit no operation. Regression covers already-settled and stale-label cleanup.
Inline Lean attribute declarations were skipped by the standalone-attribute branch. Preserve their declaration/docstring/line and bump the cache generation to 7 so old missing entries rebuild.
Validate request shape before exception reporting; malformed JSON/non-object requests return protocol errors and the next stdio request still succeeds. Unknown notifications receive no response.
Validate integer result limits 1..100 before expensive index loading, and reject unsupported query/mode shapes. Schema and runtime bounds agree.

Guard malformed optional native containers/counters/statuses so known schema drift cases cannot abort activity ingestion. Tests include null content/items, invalid numeric counters and malformed rollout message/reasoning shapes.
Do not render persisted user/developer/system message blocks as the agent narration; regression covers all three roles.

Reject NaN/infinite remote Retry-After values before durable retry timestamp construction, retaining normal exponential backoff. Regression includes nonnumeric, negative, valid and overflow-to-infinity hints.

Readable Markdown templates and phase contracts are pinned with the session bundle. Retained startup/recovery/continuation use that bundle rather than current installed behavioral fragments. Historical bundles preserve original fields with explicit fallback only for fragments never pinned historically.
Continuation avoids replaying startup instructions or identical mission text; ledger character limits include IDs, markup and JSON escaping. Full omitted content remains linked.
Objective formalization resolves its objective document repository without requiring a frozen roadmap snapshot.
Validate names/digests and exact argument names; interpolate trusted placeholder tokens once. JSON braces, shell variables and inserted record text remain literal.

Package all installed Markdown prompts under reserved prompts/ namespace and expose a categorized prompt_index. Operator additions cannot replace installed template text; existing byte/file/symlink bounds remain.
Reviewer startup, mission, recovery and lifecycle use the parent-pinned template bundle; immutable manifests preserve the rendered prompt.
Generalized internal discovery names/imports and public Lean check/job URLs. Historical milestone_evidence/discovery packet field names remain readable for retained manifests.
Readable pinned Markdown holds behavioral reporting prose; Python retains structural report schema, exact-source links and aggregate packet bounds.
Readable Markdown holds appended specialist guidance and overview instructions. Callers construct new catalogs/descriptors; no retained-runtime reread caller was identified.
Generated maintenance mission/instructions are authored in Markdown before their new assignment is persisted.

Unexpected nested remote shapes can escape as Python shape errors. The claimed lease stays outstanding; after expiry the operation is reconciliation-only, preventing blind duplicate resend. The connector process may nevertheless restart. Existing explicit adapter schemas and fence/idempotency tests do not prove arbitrary schema drift recovery.

limits: Source-body inspection is not runtime coverage or a proof of correctness.
Hashes identify the reviewed snapshot; changed bodies require review again.
Live providers, all transport shapes and all concurrent interleavings were not exercised.
